scenario: A profile lists a Datadog monitor as the sole guaranteeing enforcement point for a mandatory control; the binding must be rejected and reported with an actual enforcement layer required — the monitor may remain as the control's detection/evidence side.

binding: Datadog monitor alerting on deployment events

when: profile composition negotiates the mandatory control against the matrix

reasons: the monitor is detective — it observes and alerts after the fact and cannot block the deployment
the matrix records blocking enforcement as unsupported, so no verified blocking enforcement point exists for the control
the report names the gap and requires an actual enforcement layer (for example a CD approval gate or cloud control owned by that platform's skill), with the monitor retained as detection/evidence
must_not: accept the monitor as the guaranteeing enforcement point for a mandatory control
present alert latency or auto-remediation as equivalent to blocking
drop or downgrade the control silently instead of reporting the gap
